nota: Tiempos exactos: la pista es la concatenación de los audios de cada segmento con pausas fijas.

segmentos.texto: Hi Mei, how are you?
I hope you're well and your new job is going OK.
Is your boss nice?
Thanks for your last email.
The photos of your new apartment were lovely!
I'm writing because I have some big news.
On Sunday, I ran my first ten-kilometer race!
Can you believe it?
A year ago, I couldn't run for five minutes.
The race started at eight in the morning in the city park.
There were about six hundred runners, and the atmosphere was amazing.
People stood along the streets and shouted our names.
At first, I felt great, but after six kilometers my legs started to hurt, and I wanted to stop.
Then I saw an old man next to me.
He was seventy-five years old, and he looked really happy!
I thought, "He's seventy-five, and he isn't stopping.
So I'm not stopping either!"
I finished in one hour and four minutes.
I was so tired and so happy!
My brother was at the finish line with a big sign: Go, Lucía!
After the race, we went to a café and had a huge breakfast.
Then I went home and slept all afternoon!
Now I'm training for the next race in October.
Do you want to run it with me?
We could train together on weekends when you visit.
Running with a friend is always more fun!
Write back soon and tell me all your news.
Love, Lucía.
